subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Ponzi vs. Pyramid: What's the Difference
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ponzi vs. Pyramid: What's the Difference.

hook.text: People mix up Ponzi schemes and pyramid schemes. They share DNA but work differently.

buildup.text: A Ponzi scheme has one operator collecting money and faking returns. Investors don't recruit.

discovery.text: A pyramid scheme requires each participant to recruit new members, who recruit more members.

twist.text: A Ponzi collapses when money runs out. A pyramid collapses when recruits run out.

climax.text: Both are unsustainable, but pyramids spread guilt wider — every participant recruits victims.

punchline.text: One has a villain. The other makes everyone a villain.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between Ponzi and pyramid schemes?
options: Pyramid schemes require participants to recruit
